faq.label: Frequently asked
faq.title: Everything you need to know.
faq.subtitle: Can't find an answer? Write us, we're happy to help.
faq.q1: How does the 7-day free trial work?
faq.a1: When you sign up, no credit card is required. You get full access to all features for 7 days, completely free. After the trial, you can choose — continue for €12/mo (Basic), €24/mo (Pro) or stay on the free FREE plan. We never charge you automatically.
faq.a2: Yes. No notice period, no penalties. Just click "Cancel subscription" in settings and you can keep using until the end of your paid period. Your data stays safely stored — if you return, you'll find everything in its place.
faq.a3: Housio runs on trusted European infrastructure (Supabase, Vercel) with servers in the EU. All data is encrypted, automatically backed up and protected under GDPR. We never sell or share your contracts and tenants' personal data for others' purposes — we only use vetted infrastructure processors bound by contract. See the Security & data page for details.
faq.q4: Which countries does Housio work in?
faq.a4: Housio is designed for the whole EU. We support Czech, English, German, Italian, Spanish, Ukrainian, Russian, French, Polish and Croatian. You can work in CZK, EUR, PLN, CHF and other currencies. Whether you're a landlord in Prague, Vienna, Berlin, Rome or Madrid — Housio understands you.
faq.q5: What if I have more than 15 properties?
faq.a5: The Basic plan covers up to 15 properties for €12/mo. For 16–25 properties use the Pro plan (€24/mo) with PDF reports and priority support. For unlimited properties choose Business (€40/mo) with 3 team members and API access (coming soon).
faq.q6: Can I use Housio on mobile?
faq.a6: Yes. Housio is fully responsive — it works equally well on mobile, tablet and desktop. No app installation needed. Just open housio.online in your browser, sign in and have everything in one place. Everything syncs in real time.
faq.q7: Do you send contract expiration alerts?
faq.a7: Yes, automatically. Housio notifies you by email 30, 14 and 7 days before contract end. Never forget to renew and never lose a tenant. You'll also receive notifications about unpaid rent or approaching insurance expiration.
faq.a8: Absolutely. You generate PDF reports for accountants, banks or tax advisors from the Pro plan up — done in seconds. You can also export your data to Excel anytime (from the Basic plan). API access to integrate your own systems is coming soon on the Business plan. Your data is always yours — no vendor lock-in.
faq.emailUs: Write us an email and we'll respond within 24 hours.

security.title: Your data, safe and under control
security.subtitle: Where your data runs, who processes it and how we protect it. Transparent — for landlords and companies alike.
security.infraBody: Housio runs on trusted European infrastructure. All data is encrypted in transit and at rest, automatically backed up and processed in line with GDPR.
security.infra2: Encryption in transit and at rest
security.procSubtitle: Housio does not sell your data. To run the service it relies only on these vetted processors, each under a data processing agreement:
security.procVercel: Hosting of the Housio website and app
security.procNote: Primary data storage is in the EU. Some processors may process data outside the EU under Standard Contractual Clauses (SCC) in line with GDPR.
security.sharingBody: We never sell your data or your tenants' personal data, nor share it for third parties' own purposes. We use it solely to run the service, and only via the infrastructure processors listed above, bound by contract.
security.dpaBody: Are you a company that needs a signed Data Processing Agreement (DPA) for GDPR? We're happy to provide one on request.
security.reportBody: Found a vulnerability or have a security question? Write to us — we take it seriously and will reply as soon as possible.

partneri.stepsSub: No hassle. Sign up, share your link, and track your earnings online.
partneri.step1Body: Fill in a quick application. We'll approve you and set up your partner account — plus you get Basic free for a year.

partneri.step3Body: Every time a client pays, your commission rolls in. You can see it all online in your own dashboard — what's come in and what to invoice.
partneri.term1Body: A one-time bonus the moment your client becomes a paying customer.
partneri.term2Body: Recurring every month, for as long as your client keeps paying.
partneri.term3Body: On their first month — your code makes Housio an even easier recommendation.

partneri.ben1Body: Use Housio for your own properties at no cost — so you truly know what you're recommending.
partneri.ben2Body: See at any time how many people came through you, how much you've earned, and what to invoice.

partneri.formTitle: I'd like to become a partner
partneri.successBody: We'll be in touch and set up your partner account so you can track your earnings.
partneri.formNote: By submitting, you agree to your contact details being processed for partnership purposes.
partneri.errGeneric: Something went wrong, please try again.
partneri.faq1A: Nothing. Joining the program is free — no entry or monthly fees. On top of that, you get Basic free for a year.
partneri.faq2Q: When and how do I get my commissions paid?
partneri.faq2A: Once your accumulated earnings pass 1,000 CZK, you issue an invoice and we pay you out. You track it all online in your dashboard.
partneri.faq3Q: What exactly do I earn commission on?
partneri.faq3A: On payments from clients who came through your link or discount code and pay for Housio on the web. 20% on the first payment, 10% on every one after.
partneri.faq4Q: How long do the commissions keep coming?
partneri.faq4A: Your recurring 10% commission lands every month for as long as your client keeps paying for Housio.
